notes: It's time for another round of balance changes! In this patch, we're lending a hand to champions who haven't quite found their footing in the new meta, while taking some power away from those who've been enjoying a little too much success. We're also giving assassins some extra tools to help them turn early leads into victories, adjusting item options across several classes, and tuning a few runes that have been stealing the spotlight. We've also got some jungle adjustments to round things out. Let's get into the changes!
Reminder: content will be released throughout the patch.

blades.summary: Volibear has been having a tough time finding his footing this patch, so we're giving him some extra Attack Damage scaling and survivability to help him make a bigger impact in teamfights.

blocks.title: Frenzied Maul
lines: Empowered Healing based on Missing Health: 5/6/7/8% → 5%/8%/11%/14%

blades.summary: Jhin has been struggling to keep up this patch, so we're shifting some of his power earlier in the game to help him hit his power spikes sooner, rather than having to wait until max level to really shine.

blocks.title: Whisper
lines: Damage based on missing Health:11% - 25% (reach the cap at level 15) → 11.5% - 25% (reach the cap at level 10)

blades.summary: Tryndamere hasn't been getting as much out of the recent crit item overhaul as we'd hoped, so we're making some changes to help his Critical Strikes and overall damage output feel more consistent.

blocks.title: Battle Fury
lines: Critical Strike Chance per Fury: 0.3%–0.5% (based on level) → 0.5%

blocks.title: Spinning Slash
lines: Damage: 80/120/160/200 + 100% Bonus Attack Damage + 80% Ability Power → 80/130/180/230 + 110% Bonus Attack Damage + 80% Ability Power

blades.summary: Hwei is still painting a little too far outside the lines when it comes to his overall power, so we're dialing back his consistent damage, shielding, and crowd control to give his opponents more room to fight back.

blocks.title: Signature of the Visionary
lines: Damage: 40 - 285 (Based on level) + 30% Ability Power → 30 - 280 (Based on level) + 25% Ability Power

blocks.title: Subject: Serenity - Pool of Reflection
lines: Initial shield: 60/80/100/120 + 35% Ability Power → 50/70/90/110 + 30% Ability Power
Maximum shield: 108/128/148/168 + 71% Ability Power → 98/118/138/158 + 60% Ability Power

blocks.title: Subject: Torment - Crushing Maw
lines: Optimized the hitbox of the jaws

blades.summary: Following the jungle overhaul, Nocturne has been clearing camps and hunting down his enemies a little too efficiently. We're dialing back his jungle clear speed and ability to find opportunities to strike, giving his prey a little more breathing room before darkness falls.

We've been happy with Yunara's performance since her release, but as players have gotten more comfortable with her kit, she's started to become a little too powerful. We're dialing back some of her sustained damage to bring her more in line with other marksmen.

Senna continues to stand above the rest of the roster, so we're taking another pass at her scaling to bring her power more in line with other champions and give both marksmen and supports more room to shine.

blocks.title: Absolution
lines: Attack Damage per Black Mist stack: 1.25 → 0.9

blades.summary: Yasuo has been struggling since losing the crit version of Bloodthirster, so we're giving him some extra damage and survivability in the mid to late game to help him hold his own as fights heat up.

blocks.title: Way of the Wanderer
lines: Shield Value: 77 - 529 (Based on level) → 77 - 630 (Based on level)

blocks.title: GAMEPLAY CHANGES
notes: Assassins have been struggling to turn early leads into wins, even when they manage to get ahead. We're making a series of changes to their items and runes to give them more opportunities to snowball their advantages and make their early successes feel more rewarding.

blocks.title: Locket of the Iron Solari
notes: We're giving Locket of the Iron Solari a boost to make it a more appealing option for tank supports. This should help tank supports better protect their carries and close the gap between playing alongside a tank support versus an enchanter.

blocks.title: Thornmail
notes: Thornmail has been offering a little too much value for its cost, giving tanks access to a large amount of Armor and Grievous Wounds earlier than intended. We're adjusting its cost to better align with other first completed items across classes and keep power spikes at a more consistent pace.

blocks.title: Warmog's Armor
notes: Warmog's Armor has been finding its way into a few too many builds, especially among enchanter supports who aren't necessarily looking for all that extra Health. We're adjusting its requirements to make it a less appealing option for enchanters while keeping it a reliable choice for tank supports.

blocks.title: Statikk Shiv
notes: Statikk Shiv hasn't been quite keeping up with other item options, so we're giving it a small boost to help it feel like a more rewarding pickup.

blocks.title: Yun Tal Wildarrows
notes: Despite our previous buffs, Yun Tal Wildarrows is still struggling to keep up with other marksman items. We're lowering its cost to make it a more competitive option and help its users hit their power spikes a little sooner.

blocks.title: Electrocute
lines: Damage: 40 - 210 (Based on level) + 10% Bonus Attack Damage + 5% Ability Power → 60 - 210 (Based on level) + 10% Bonus Attack Damage + 5% Ability Power

blocks.title: Grasp of the Undying
notes: Grasp of the Undying has been gaining an edge over Conqueror, so we're dialing back some of its laning damage and scaling. This should help keep it from overshadowing other rune choices or letting champions bypass their intended strengths and weaknesses.

blocks.title: Aery
notes: With the new support items making it easier to trigger Aery's shield more frequently, she's been providing a little too much protection. We're dialing back her late-game shielding power to keep her in line with other rune options.
lines: Shield value: 25 - 120 (Based on level) + 10% Bonus Attack Damage + 5% Ability Power → 20-100 (Based on level) + 10% Bonus Attack Damage + 5% Ability Power

blocks.title: Jungle Monsters
notes: Raptors have become a little too easy to clear in the mid and late game, making them an easy target for jungle invades. We're making them a bit tougher to take down to reduce the pressure on junglers defending their camps.

blocks.title: Soothing Slipstream
lines: Healing effects: 1.5% Maximum Health → 1% Maximum Health

blocks.title: Rock Solid
lines: Damage Reduction: 3.75 - 14.25 (Based on level) → 3.5 - 10.5 (Based on level)

blocks.title: Poro Head
lines: Damage Reduction: 3 - 15 (Based on level) → 3 - 12 (Based on level)

blocks.title: Eureka
lines: Ability Haste: 25% Bonus Attack Damage + 12% Ability Power → 20% Bonus Attack Damage+10% Ability Power

blocks.title: Upgrade Sword of Blossoming Dawn
lines: Reduced basic Attack Damage converted into healing ratio: 100% → 300%

blocks.title: Bigger and Bigger
lines: Bonus Health on each take down participation: 15 → 30

blocks.title: Fast and Furious
lines: Movement Speed and Attack Speed gained on Critical Strike: 15% → 25%

blocks.title: BUG FIXES
lines: Fixed an issue where Yun Tal Wildarrows' Attack Speed effect would occasionally trigger incorrectly.
Fixed an issue where activating Yordle Snap Trap would reduce Armor and Magic Resist.
Fixed an issue with the description of Smolder's (1).
Fixed an issue with the cast range of Veigar's (1).

blocks.title: Guild Leaderboard Settlement Rules Optimization
notes: Optimized the timing of Guild Leaderboard point calculations. Rankings will now be calculated based on points at 11:55 PM every Sunday, with the leaderboard refreshing at 12:00 AM.
